name: set up and verify password-based SSH between host and qemu guest
definition: Install/configure the SSH daemon inside the guest with root password auth and confirm the host can authenticate into the guest shell.
failure_mode: Any break in boot, network, or ssh config fails the remote command.

name: make a successful pdflatex build free of over-filled box warnings (e.g. via synonym substitution)
definition: make a successful pdflatex build free of over-filled box warnings (e.g. via synonym substitution)
failure_mode: missing a line still over-filled, or using a forbidden synonym, leaves a warning or trips the protection check

name: point outbound list mail to local user mailboxes
definition: configure local mail delivery for addresses so each subscriber's mailbox receives the announcement
failure_mode: delivery misconfig mails to wrong path or not at all
